item.title: Austin bar attack: Suspect Ndiaga Diagne’s background under scrutiny in terror probe
item.description: The suspect who killed two people and wounded 14 others was shot dead by police; the FBI said the shooting is being investigated as a potential act of terrorism

item.title: Kashmir imposes curbs, schools closed, internet throttled amid Khamenei protests
item.description: Authorities enforce movement restrictions, close schools, and throttle internet in Kashmir, deploying security forces and sealing key areas to maintain peace amid protests

item.title: JNU protest march: Student leaders among 14 protesters released from jail
item.description: Court orders immediate release of JNUSU members held after scuffle with police during march against VC's remarks and UGC norms; student groups call it a ‘victory’ and vow to continue agitation

item.title: West Asia conflict grounds Gulf flights in Kerala and Kolkata
item.description: Mass cancellations enter third day across Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, and Kolkata; airlines warn of extended disruptions as regional airspace remains volatile

item.title: Stranded in Dubai amid Iran conflict, Sindhu to miss All England Championships
item.description: Two-time Olympic medallist stranded in Dubai after US-Iran airstrikes close Gulf airspace, forcing withdrawal; fellow Indian shuttlers continue tournament with altered travel routes

item.title: Nagpur blast: 9 SBL Energy directors arrested, case against 21 officials
item.description: At least 20 people were killed and nearly 24 critically injured in a powerful explosion at SBL Energy Limited’s ammunition manufacturing unit on Sunday morning

item.title: Omar Abdullah under fire from NC MP for not condemning Khamenei assassination
item.description: The Srinagar MP says the chief minister’s expression of 'concern' lacked the moral clarity expected from a leader representing a large Muslim electorate

item.title: Ajit Pawar’s son demands action against VSR owner over 'cockpit video'
item.description: In a purported video on social media, owner of VSR Ventures Rohit Singh was seen sleeping on the chief pilot's seat during a flight

item.title: West Asia conflict: Kerala defers SSLC, Higher Secondary exams in Gulf region
item.description: The revised dates for the exams slated for March 5, 6, and 7 in the region will be announced later, said Kerala General Education Minister Sivankutty

item.title: Deepam row: Stalin defends TN govt stance, amidst PM’s visit to Tirupparankundram temple
item.description: TN CM said personal faith should not bow down to politics, and that he made a choice to safeguard the tradition of the temple as a chief minister and not as a religious leader
